description: Erection of a single storey side extension with conversion of garage into a habitable room and insertion of larger patio doors to the rear elevation of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 1152/P/1250/001. Received 05/02/19. Design and access statement, 1152/P/100/001 Revision B, 1152/P/100/002 Revision B, 1152/P/100/003 Revision B. Received 27/03/19  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
